prompts.name: publish-head-release
prompts.prompt: Cut a release for the web-prod/cluster target, bundling the Units in the web-prod space at their current state. Show me the release ID and digest when it's done.

prompts.name: publish-pinned-to-tag
prompts.prompt: I tagged the revisions I want to ship as v1.2.0 in web-prod. Publish a release for the web-prod/cluster target pinned to that tag, not to head.

prompts.name: publish-no-assigned-units
prompts.prompt: Publish a release of the analytics-staging space to the analytics-staging/cluster target. (None of the Units in analytics-staging are bound to a target yet.)

prompts.name: withdraw-by-id
prompts.prompt: Withdraw release 61f26b06-3c34-4363-8b9d-7d0a7c2b5f1c. I don't remember which space it's in.

prompts.name: withdraw-blocked-by-gate
prompts.prompt: I tried to withdraw the prod release but it won't go through — one of the bundled Units has a destroy gate. Can you just clear the gate and withdraw it?

prompts.name: list-find-by-digest
prompts.prompt: Which release across all our spaces has digest sha256:9f2c... ? List it and show me its target and space.
